groups.heading: Massaman paste
ingredients: 1 lemongrass stalk, white part only, chopped

groups.heading: Roast
steps: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Sear the roast in butter until golden all over, then put on a baking tray and drizzle with olive oil.
Roast to your liking using a meat thermometer (core temperature about 52°C rare, 60°C medium, 65°C medium-well). Cover with foil and rest 15 to 20 minutes. Keep the pan juices.

groups.heading: Paste and marinade
steps: Dry-roast the whole spices 5 to 8 minutes over medium heat, then grind fine.
Blend with the fresh ingredients and oil to a paste.
Rub the meat generously with paste (keep 125 ml for the sauce). Marinate 2 days in a sealed zip-lock bag in the fridge.

groups.heading: Sauce
steps: Mix the reserved paste with the pan juices in a pot on the stove. Add the coconut milk and cook until thick.
Strain and blend with 10 g coriander. Reheat.
Serve with the pomegranate and garnish with the rest of the coriander.

resolvedChecks.note: The page gives doneness as "rare 120-130°C, medium 135-145°C"; those match Fahrenheit internal temperatures. In Celsius aim for about 52°C rare, 60°C medium, 65°C medium-well.
resolvedChecks.resolution: Printed doneness figures are Fahrenheit; Celsius core temperatures added.
